policy: Never turn a qualitative hero skill into a numeric score unless the current player value/variant is known. Community values are references, not account values.

engineEffects.notes: Command Strategy increases all team members' Attack for a timed window. WfGg uses the player's displayed Attack %, duration and cooldown; the averaged uptime is a research proxy, not exact cast-timeline simulation.
SSR Sarah MG Symphony buffs the three back-row units against Monsters for a timed window. Current displayed value/duration/cooldown are required.
UR Sarah Falcon Strike passively increases back-row Aircraft heroes' Damage to monsters. Player current displayed percentage is used.
UR Sarah Airspace Supremacy buffs allied Aircraft Attack for a timed window. WfGg requires the current displayed Attack %, duration and cooldown instead of assuming a max-level curve.

diagnosticEffects.reason: Cooldown speed changes only skill-cycle output. Applying it to all displayed ATK would overstate the effect until the share of damage coming from skills is modeled.
The passive boosts Monica's damage against monsters; the current displayed percentage is entered on Monica herself.
Published wording confirms extra damage to monster targets but does not safely establish whether the timed increase is a self-only modifier or a target-wide debuff for all allies.
The passive boosts this hero's damage to Monsters; the current displayed percentage is entered on the hero.
This is a survivability modifier and must never inflate Wanted Code offense.
Front-row monster mitigation is collected for the future calibrated survival model, but is not converted into fake power today.

references.observed: Command Strategy +16.50% Attack for 6s, 12s cooldown at the referenced state; Rapid Start +30% skill cooldown speed to the highest-ATK hero at the referenced state.
UR Airspace Supremacy boosts Aircraft Attack and UR Falcon Strike boosts back-row Aircraft monster damage; SSR MG Symphony is a distinct timed back-row monster buff.
Treasure Hunter boosts damage against monsters; Weak Spot Scan gains extra damage if the target is a monster.
Zombie Killer boosts damage to monsters.
Armor Boost protects the front row and Special Armor reduces monster damage taken.
